_comment: Every server function that sends email, writes to a CRM or Notion, or creates a service-role client must be listed (rule R2 in serverfn-guard-core.mjs). Letters: A own email, B members only, C public form, E invite, F admin-key operator route, G service-role data function (file wildcard allowed), H anonymous capability-token endpoint. Email and CRM functions are listed by name. See CLAUDE.md section 20.23.

entries.name: processInviteLinkJoin
entries.reason: Anonymous by design: an investor invite link's token is the credential. The token must be a UUID before it reaches a query; the only effect is one auto-added watchlist row for the link's investor.

entries.name: triggerWelcomeEmail
entries.reason: Welcome email to the signed-in user's own confirmed address; recipient is the verified session email; sent once per account; accepts no fields.

entries.name: triggerNdaSignedEmail
entries.reason: Tells the founder member(s) of a deal room the caller belongs to (as investor) that the NDA was signed; recipients come from membership records; min interval.

entries.name: triggerDocumentUploadedEmail
entries.reason: Tells the investor members of a deal room the caller belongs to about an upload; recipients come from membership records; min interval.

entries.name: triggerStartupTeamInvite
entries.reason: Team invite email to the address on a team_invites record the caller created and still belongs to the organisation of; open, unexpired, minimum resend interval.

entries.name: triggerLawyerInvite
entries.reason: Legal-counsel invite to the address on a deal_room_lawyer_invites record the caller created and is a room member for; open, unexpired, minimum resend interval.

entries.name: sendDealRoomInvite
entries.reason: Deal-room invite: record created with the caller's own token (RLS decides), email goes to the stored record address; strict field validation.

entries.name: submitWaitlistForm
entries.reason: Public waitlist form: strict parser, length caps, fixed source list, fixed HubSpot property allow-list.

entries.name: submitContactForm
entries.reason: Public contact form: strict parser, length caps, fixed HubSpot property allow-list.

entries.name: submitDemoRequest
entries.reason: Public demo-request form: strict parser, length caps, fixed slot list, fixed HubSpot property allow-list.

entries.name: syncOwnContact
entries.reason: Writes the signed-in user's own HubSpot contact; address is the verified session email; fixed property sets per kind.

entries.name: fetchAdminData
entries.reason: Admin-key operator route: read-only dump of feedback, waitlist and email events.

entries.name: getDiagnostics
entries.reason: Admin-key operator route: reports which environment values are set; no secret value, no email.

entries.name: runHubspotBulkSync
entries.reason: Admin-key operator route: x-admin-key plus a validated body of at most 50 users.

entries.name: getInternalData
entries.reason: Admin-key operator route: read-only dump of feedback and waitlist.

entries.name: runEmailTest
entries.reason: Admin-key operator route: sends one fixed test email to a system address.
Service-role data function (no email, CRM or Notion write); the caller is derived from their own token by a recognised auth helper (rules R1 and R3).
